original_target.title: Regularity of transport interfaces for nonconvex polyhedral targets

answer: Affirmative codimension-two regularity for full transport interfaces.
required_status_qualification: Complete resolution of the stated target in the cited source.
scope_comparison: Theorem1.1 allows an arbitrary bounded open source, bounded polyhedral target of equal volume and the given convex Brenier potential. It uses the closure of the nondifferentiability set inside source, and a relatively closed exceptional subset of Hausdorff dimension<=n-2 with smooth local hypersurfaces elsewhere. It applies in n>=2 and hence n>=3. For finite-facet domains with possible null slits, filling cells cut out by the finite facet hyperplanes changes only a null set and preserves target closure; the same potential and its nondifferentiability set remain. Local max-of-two smooth branches with distinct gradients yields embedded graphs, not just immersions.
